INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.

3. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension.

4. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)

5. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.

6. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

7. When practising Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Conversational Skills.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Conversational Skills.

   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.

9. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building.

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building.

10. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)

11. When practising Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Conversational Skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information - Visuals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Listening for information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
